answer: An agent economy can counter Sybil attacks via collateralized vouching, shielding networks from an ocean of spoofed identities. To transact, even a modest sparrow agent must obtain endorsements backed by capital staked in a decentralized trust reef. Adversaries face a verifiable cost of forfeited liquidity and slashed funds per puppet node. However, this requirement erects entry barriers for low-budget agents and risks market capture by wealthy incumbent cartels.
